summary: ZenaTech, Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K reporting multiple operational updates, chief among them the completed acquisitions of two engineering/surveying firms: Benchmark Partners LLC (doing business as Galena-Benchmark Engineering) in Idaho and a Canadian civil/structural engineering firm. These represent ZenaTech's 27th and 28th Drone-as-a-Service acquisitions, expanding its footprint to 13 U.S. states and multiple Canadian provinces. No financial terms (price, premium) were disclosed. The acquisitions aim to integrate drone-based surveying and monitoring into established professional service firms, creating recurring revenue opportunities. Watch for continued roll-up activity and integration execution.
